body:
Since T-200 a refused expense says so on its row and in the form (warning mark + the server's reason, kept on the row as syncBlockedCode/syncBlockedAccountId). Shopping and checklist items that the server quarantines (422 with row_id: invalid_name, invalid_price, unknown_list, ...) still show nothing on the row — the only signal is the Overview attention banner, which navigates to the list and leaves the user to guess which item.

Give ItemRow in ui/list/ListScreen.kt the same treatment: the warning mark with the "Not saved to the list" label (expense_not_saved) and ErrorText.refusal(code, null) for the reason where one is mapped; the EditItemDialog could show the banner the expense form shows. The data is already on the row; this is rendering only. Screen test in ListScreenTest, and the web has no equivalent because it pushes synchronously and reports at save time.
title: Android: a quarantined shopping-list item has no marker on its row, unlike an expense
